[EN] No One Left Behind
[ES] Nadie se queda atrás
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please help recover our honored dead in the Hatchery.
[ES] Por favor, ayuda a recuperar a nuestros honrados muertos en la incubadora.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We're in your debt. Thank you.
[ES] Estamos en deuda contigo. Gracias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Only too glad to help."
[ES] "Más que feliz de ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Recover mummified remains in the Hatchery.
[ES] Recupera restos momificados en la incubadora.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the remains to Janash.
[ES] Entrega los restos a Janash.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
